doc.title: Ada Rovatti interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 13, 2022

title: Upcoming jazz cruise and vacuuming instead of practicing
summary: She will go on a jazz cruise in January and jokes about avoiding practice.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: What’s the very next thing that’s going to happen performance-wise for you?
Well I have a couple of things in the next couple of weeks but then we are off on a jazz cruise at the beginning of January. So that’s going to be exciting. And that’s going to be fun.
Do you bring your own rhythm section or do they pair you up with — ?

Well sometimes we can go with our band. Some other times they pair us with different — this year I think both me and Randy we’re going to do some of the big band stuff and then they’re going to pair with different bands. But so that’s going to be exciting so I have to polish my doublings that are rusting somewhere and catching dust.
Well you mentioned the vacuum cleaner before we started to just get the vacuum out.

Yes. You know suck everything out of it. Yeah we were saying that sometimes I’d rather vacuum than practice. Unfortunately I’m good to find multiple tasking, whatever but practicing I think is a problem that a lot of musicians can relate to.
